api_base.description: The Noma API base URL. Defaults to https://api.noma.security. Also checks if the NOMA_API_KEY env var is set.

api_key.description: The Noma API key. Reads from NOMA_API_KEY env var if None.

application_id.description: The Noma Application ID. Reads from NOMA_APPLICATION_ID env var if None.

use_v2.description: If True and guardrail='noma', route to the new Noma v2 implementation.
